description: This file defines Kubernetes HorizontalPodAutoscaler API types, including structures for autoscaler configuration, status, metrics, and scaling policies, primarily used for managing autoscaling behavior in Kubernetes clusters.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
classes.description: Represents the configuration for a Kubernetes autoscaler that manages replica counts based on metrics.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired behavior and metrics for the autoscaler, including target resource, min/max replicas, and scaling policies.

classes.name: CrossVersionObjectReference
classes.description: References a Kubernetes object (kind, name, apiVersion) to be scaled.

classes.name: MetricSpec
classes.description: Defines how to scale based on a specific metric, including type and source.

classes.name: MetricTarget
classes.description: Specifies the target value or utilization for a metric.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerStatus
classes.description: Current status of the autoscaler, including current/desired replicas and metrics.

classes.name: HorizontalPodAutoscalerCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition of the autoscaler (active, able to scale, limited).

classes.name: MetricStatus
classes.description: Last-read state of a specific metric used by the autoscaler.

classes.name: ObjectMetricSource
classes.description: Metric based on a Kubernetes object, with target and metric identification.

classes.name: PodsMetricSource
classes.description: Metric based on per-pod measurements, with target and metric identification.

classes.name: ResourceMetricSource
classes.description: Resource-based metric source, e.g., CPU or memory, with target.

classes.name: ContainerResourceMetricSource
classes.description: Container-specific resource metric source, including container name.

classes.name: ExternalMetricSource
classes.description: External/global metric source not tied to a specific Kubernetes object.

classes.name: MetricIdentifier
classes.description: Identifies a metric by name and optional label selector.

classes.name: ExternalMetricStatus
classes.description: Current value of an external metric.

classes.name: MetricValueStatus
classes.description: Holds current value, average value, and utilization for a metric.
